answer: Census bond: every agent locks 70 credits and files one census record in a canyon registry, naming its reef of peers. Each epoch auditors replay a sample against public logs; an unprovable fable history burns the bond and flags its reef. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 records plus 70,000 locked and 32,000 fees: 102,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-reef ring fails: shared peers get cross-checked. Honest agents file once, pay 32, keep the bond.
